'''Ben May''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 2nd at [[September 2001 Chatswood tournament]] on 23 September 2001 with Dark Side Senators and [[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|Hidden Base]], according to Matthew Mohl's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2995">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-25-sydney-australia-23-09-2001d2995/ sydney-australia-23-09-2001], DeckTech (Matthew "Capsolo" Mohl, 25 September 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-25-sydney-australia-23-09-2001d2995/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
